lines.zh: 我张着嘴慢慢游，把海水滤成食物。
lines.en: I swim slowly with my mouth open, filtering the sea.

lines.zh: 我体型大，可每一步都不着急。
lines.en: I am huge, but not a single stroke hurries.

lines.zh: 浮游生物在我嘴边排成一道白线。
lines.en: Plankton gathers in a white line at my mouth.

lines.zh: 小鱼跟着我，捡我漏下的碎屑。
lines.en: Small fish trail me, picking up what I miss.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚上方掠过，不碰它一下。
lines.en: I pass over the coral without touching it.

lines.zh: 这具身体太长，转弯要绕很大一圈。
lines.en: This body is so long, turns take a wide arc.

lines.zh: 我沿着洋流走，让水替我出力。
lines.en: I ride the current and let the water do the work.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍一扫，把沙推到旁边。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail pushes the sand aside.

lines.zh: 滤食者不需要追，只需要张嘴。
lines.en: A filter feeder does not chase, only opens wide.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶游过，挡住了一整片天。
lines.en: I pass over your head and block out the sky.

lines.zh: 鲨鱼也可以只吃很小的东西。
lines.en: A shark can live on very small things.

lines.zh: 我贴着海面游，背鳍晒着太阳。
lines.en: I cruise the surface, my fin drying in the sun.

lines.zh: 水进嘴里，水又出来，饭留在里面。
lines.en: Water in, water out, and the meal stays.

lines.zh: 我游过的路，水会慢慢合上。
lines.en: The water closes slowly behind my path.

lines.zh: 我从一大群小鱼中间穿过去。
lines.en: I glide through a crowd of small fish.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤上有星星一样的斑点。
lines.en: Stars of spots cover my skin.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，把浮游生物滤进水。
lines.en: Mouth open, I filter the plankton from the current.

lines.zh: 浅一点的海底，阳光在水上晃。
lines.en: Shallower now, light wobbles above me.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，让浮游生物自己飘进来。
lines.en: I hover and let the plankton drift in.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，嘴张得像一扇门。
lines.en: I yawn, my mouth opening like a door.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过海面，落在我背上。
lines.en: Sunlight pierces the surface and lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，鱼也不怕我。
lines.en: I do nothing, and the fish do not fear me.

lines.zh: 这么慢的鲨鱼，连水都懒得推我。
lines.en: So slow a shark that the water hardly pushes me.

lines.zh: 我听见鲸歌，很远，像在打鼾。
lines.en: I hear whale song far off, like snoring.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴睡着了一小会儿。
lines.en: I doze off with my mouth still open.

lines.zh: 滤食的日子很闲，也很饱。
lines.en: Filter feeding is idle work, and filling.

lines.zh: 我翻身时，整片海都晃了一下。
lines.en: When I roll over, the whole sea sways.

lines.zh: 水里的光斑从我皮肤上一块块滑过。
lines.en: Patches of light slide across my skin.

lines.zh: 这只海龟比我还急。
lines.en: That turtle is in more of a hurry than I am.

lines.zh: 我数不清自己滤过多少海水。
lines.en: I cannot count the water I have filtered.

lines.zh: 我的体重压得沙面凹下去一块。
lines.en: My weight presses a dent into the sand.

lines.zh: 什么都不做，也算滤食者的一天。
lines.en: Doing nothing still counts as a filter feeder's day.

lines.zh: 你在我面前显得很小，我不介意。
lines.en: You look tiny before me, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴滤水，顺便看你。
lines.en: I filter water with my mouth open, and watch you.

lines.zh: 你身上没有浮游生物，我有点失望。
lines.en: You carry no plankton, which disappoints me.

lines.zh: 我把嘴合上，免得吓到你。
lines.en: I close my mouth so I do not scare you.

lines.zh: 你挥手，我以为是水流在动。
lines.en: You wave; I mistake it for moving water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，只想看看你的形状。
lines.en: I drift closer, only to study your shape.

lines.zh: 你的船比我还小。
lines.en: Your boat is smaller than I am.

lines.zh: 我对视的方式是原地不动。
lines.en: My way of meeting your eyes is to stay still.

lines.zh: 你退后了，我跟着退了一点。
lines.en: You back away, and I drift back a little too.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在两侧，看你要转过来。
lines.en: My eyes sit on either side; seeing you takes a turn.

lines.zh: 你砍在我背上，皮太厚，只留白痕。
lines.en: Your blade lands on my back and leaves only a pale line.

lines.zh: 我疼得猛甩尾巴，掀起一片浪。
lines.en: The pain makes me whip my tail into a wave.

lines.zh: 我没生气，只是有点不解。
lines.en: I am not angry, only a little confused.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出的血在水里散成雾。
lines.en: Blood from the wound blooms into mist.

lines.zh: 滤食者也会疼，只是叫得小声。
lines.en: Filter feeders feel pain too, just quietly.

lines.zh: 你打第二下时，我开始往深处沉。
lines.en: At your second blow, I begin to sink deeper.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我嘴里的水流。
lines.en: The blow breaks the flow of water in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的皮很厚，可你的箭找到了缝。
lines.en: My hide is thick, but your arrow found a gap.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，想看清是谁。
lines.en: I turn slowly, wanting to see who did that.

lines.zh: 疼让我闭了嘴，第一次。
lines.en: The pain makes me close my mouth, for once.

lines.zh: 你把鱼食撒下来，我张嘴接住。
lines.en: You scatter fish feed and I open to catch it.

lines.zh: 浮游生物的气味比鱼腥更吸引我。
lines.en: Plankton smells better to me than fish blood.

lines.zh: 我滤到一把小鱼，味道不错。
lines.en: I filter a mouthful of small fish; not bad.

lines.zh: 你举着桶，我就跟着桶走。
lines.en: You hold up a bucket; I follow the bucket.

lines.zh: 我这体型，追食物只追半米。
lines.en: At my size, I chase food for half a block.

lines.zh: 别拿血逗我，那不合我胃口。
lines.en: Do not tempt me with blood; it is not my taste.

lines.zh: 一片虾群飘来，我转了个大弯。
lines.en: A swarm of krill drifts by and I make a wide turn.

lines.zh: 我把嘴凑近你的手，什么也没咬。
lines.en: I bring my mouth to your hand and bite nothing.

lines.zh: 这口海水很浓，我多喝了两口。
lines.en: This mouthful is rich, so I take two more.

lines.zh: 食物在水里散开，我慢慢过去。
lines.en: The food spreads through the water; I drift over.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞在会动的地形上。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting moving terrain.

lines.zh: 我太宽，你只能从我侧面蹭过去。
lines.en: I am too wide; you can only squeeze past my flank.

lines.zh: 我撞到你，自己也吓了一跳。
lines.en: I bump you and startle myself.

lines.zh: 我的皮很厚，你的剑几乎没感觉。
lines.en: My hide is thick; your sword hardly registers.

lines.zh: 你被挤开两格，我还在原地滤水。
lines.en: You get pushed two blocks; I keep filtering.

lines.zh: 我转身时尾巴扫到了你的船。
lines.en: My tail clips your boat as I turn.

lines.zh: 撞我一下不疼，但会让你滑倒。
lines.en: Bumping me does not hurt, but it makes you slip.

lines.zh: 我们互相挡住，谁都不急。
lines.en: We block each other, and neither hurries.

lines.zh: 我尽量侧身，可这身体不太听话。
lines.en: I try to turn aside, but this body rarely listens.

lines.zh: 你贴着我游，水流舒服多了。
lines.en: Swimming against me, the current feels easier.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，像两段移动的礁石。
lines.en: We swim side by side, two moving reefs.

lines.zh: 我碰她的侧腹，她慢慢偏过来。
lines.en: I nudge her flank and she slowly leans in.

lines.zh: 两条大影子在海面上并行。
lines.en: Two huge shadows run parallel on the surface.

lines.zh: 我们滤同一片浮游生物。
lines.en: We filter the same patch of plankton.

lines.zh: 她比我慢，我就在前面等她。
lines.en: She is slower, so I wait ahead for her.

lines.zh: 我们的尾鳍拍出同一节奏。
lines.en: Our tails beat out the same rhythm.

lines.zh: 这么大的身体，靠近时却很轻。
lines.en: Such large bodies, yet we meet so gently.

lines.zh: 这片海够宽，够养大它们。
lines.en: This sea is wide enough to raise them.

lines.zh: 她转开时，我跟着绕了一圈。
lines.en: When she turns away, I follow a full circle.

lines.zh: 安静地并游，就是我们的样子。
lines.en: Swimming quietly together is simply our way.

lines.zh: 我滤到一块木板，又吐了出来。
lines.en: I filter up a plank and spit it out.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沉下来，我推回给你。
lines.en: Your boot sinks down; I push it back to you.

lines.zh: 掉落的蛋我含在嘴里，不知怎么办。
lines.en: I hold a dropped egg, unsure what to do.

lines.zh: 海带卡在我牙缝里，很不舒服。
lines.en: Kelp is stuck between my teeth, unpleasant.

lines.zh: 小鱼叼走了我嘴边的东西。
lines.en: A small fish steals what was at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我试着吃铁锭，滤不进去。
lines.en: I try to eat an ingot; it will not filter.

lines.zh: 这堆碎屑里有亮晶晶的砂。
lines.en: This pile of debris holds glittering sand.

lines.zh: 我把东西顶起来，看它浮走。
lines.en: I nudge it up and watch it float away.

lines.zh: 你丢的鱼我全收了。
lines.en: Every fish you drop, I take.

lines.zh: 我嘴边的东西往往不是食物。
lines.en: What reaches my mouth usually is not food.

lines.zh: 我很少锁定谁，你刚好挡了水。
lines.en: I rarely lock onto anyone; you are in my current.

lines.zh: 我朝你游来，其实只是顺路。
lines.en: I swim toward you, honestly just passing through.

lines.zh: 虾群在你身后，我追的是虾群。
lines.en: The krill is behind you; I follow the krill.

lines.zh: 你打了我，我才第一次正眼看你。
lines.en: You hit me, and only then do I look at you.

lines.zh: 我把你当成一块浮着的东西。
lines.en: I take you for something floating.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向，目标其实很小。
lines.en: I turn slowly, and my target is very small.

lines.zh: 水流把你的气味送到我嘴边。
lines.en: The current delivers your scent to my mouth.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴靠近，是为了滤水。
lines.en: I approach open-mouthed, only to filter.

lines.zh: 比起追你，我更想追那片阴影。
lines.en: Rather than chase you, I would chase that shadow.

lines.zh: 锁定之后，我还在犹豫。
lines.en: Even locked on, I keep hesitating.

lines.zh: 我跟着你游，游得很慢。
lines.en: I follow you, very slowly.

lines.zh: 你回头看我，我又拉开距离。
lines.en: You glance back and I fall behind again.

lines.zh: 我大，可我不擅长拐弯。
lines.en: I am large, but I turn badly.

lines.zh: 你游到浅处，我就停下了。
lines.en: You head for the shallows and I stop.

lines.zh: 我在算这口能不能容下你。
lines.en: I am working out whether you fit in my mouth.

lines.zh: 水流一直把你往我这边送。
lines.en: The current keeps delivering you toward me.

lines.zh: 我不急，滤食者从不急。
lines.en: I am in no rush; filter feeders never are.

lines.zh: 你越是挣扎，水越浑。
lines.en: The more you struggle, the murkier the water.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，然后忘了自己在追什么。
lines.en: I open my mouth, then forget what I was chasing.

lines.zh: 你走远后，我改追一片虾。
lines.en: After you leave, I chase a patch of krill instead.

lines.zh: 我不是要咬你，是顺手吸进来的。
lines.en: I did not mean to bite you; you came with the water.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，这一下比咬还重。
lines.en: I ram you, and it lands harder than a bite.

lines.zh: 你被我的嘴吸住，慌忙蹬水。
lines.en: My mouth pulls you in and you kick in panic.

lines.zh: 我的牙很小，可嘴很大。
lines.en: My teeth are tiny, but my mouth is vast.

lines.zh: 这一撞把你推出去好几格。
lines.en: This bump throws you several blocks.

lines.zh: 我甩头，你从嘴边滑了出去。
lines.en: I shake my head and you slide free of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我压过来，水的重量先到了。
lines.en: I bear down, and the weight of water arrives first.

lines.zh: 别在我张嘴时靠近。
lines.en: Do not come close while my mouth is open.

lines.zh: 我不追第二下，第一下已经够了。
lines.en: I do not follow up; the first hit was plenty.

lines.zh: 你撞在我牙床上，声音很闷。
lines.en: You hit my tooth plate with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我从深水升起，光一点点变亮。
lines.en: I rise from deep water and the light grows.

lines.zh: 这么小的刷怪蛋，装得下我？
lines.en: Such a small spawn egg, and it holds me?

lines.zh: 配置把我的权重写进了这片海。
lines.en: The config wrote my weight into this sea.

lines.zh: 我第一次张嘴，就滤到了食物。
lines.en: My first open mouth already caught a meal.

lines.zh: 海面很宽，我慢慢长到这么大。
lines.en: The sea is wide, and I grew to this size slowly.

lines.zh: 我一出生就挡住了洋流。
lines.en: At birth I already blocked the current.

lines.zh: 原版海域里，我算温和的那种。
lines.en: Among the vanilla seas, I am the gentle sort.

lines.zh: 我落下时，周围的水都退开。
lines.en: When I landed, the water around me pushed away.

lines.zh: 我先学会滤水，再学会转身。
lines.en: I learned to filter before I learned to turn.

lines.zh: 你看见我时，我已经游远了。
lines.en: By the time you saw me, I had already moved on.

lines.zh: 水面在烧，我往冷的那边沉。
lines.en: The surface burns; I sink toward the cold.

lines.zh: 我从水面砸下去，浪花比船高。
lines.en: I crash down and the splash rises above the boat.

lines.zh: 我滤了一辈子水，也会被水呛。
lines.en: I have filtered water all my life, yet I choke.

lines.zh: 爆炸的水压挤得我内脏发闷。
lines.en: The blast pressure squeezes my insides dull.

lines.zh: 三叉戟扎进我的鳍，拔不出来。
lines.en: A trident sticks in my fin and will not come out.

lines.zh: 紫光扫过，我的鳃一阵刺痛。
lines.en: Purple light sweeps past and my gills sting.

lines.zh: 水里没东西可滤，我开始发慌。
lines.en: Nothing left to filter, and I begin to panic.

lines.zh: 雷劈进海里，我整个身子都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 水到尽头了，下面什么都没有。
lines.en: The water ends here, and below is nothing.
